title: The Icon Demands Their Title Back
narrativeText: One of the four sends you a message: the Extreme Championship was never yours to keep. They're taking it back — in the most violent match either of you has ever had.

choices.label: Stand Your Ground
choices.text: The title is yours. No extreme icon is taking it without a war.

title: The Outsider's Last Statement
narrativeText: The Barbwire Exploding Deathmatch is signed. You have one moment before the most dangerous match of your career. The crowd knows who you are now.

choices.label: Rally the Crowd
choices.text: You may have started as an outsider. But this crowd is yours now.

choices.label: Silent, Steely Resolve
choices.text: No words. Just the look of someone who has already decided they will not lose.

title: The Outsider's Barbwire Deathmatch
narrativeText: The ring is wrapped in barbwire. The crowd — your crowd now — is on its feet. This is the match that will define your entire extreme journey: an outsider who went further than anyone thought possible.

choices.label: Enter the Barbwire
choices.text: Outsider. Champion. Legend. You decide which one it ends on.

title: The Outsider Legend
narrativeText: The explosions fade. The barbwire is still. You stand, bleeding, holding the ATW Extreme Championship above your head. The crowd — extreme faithful who have seen every icon — chants your name. An outsider became the most extreme champion in ATW history.

title: Reclaimed by the Extreme
narrativeText: The barbwire has the last word. You fought with everything you had — further than any outsider has ever gone in the extreme underground. But the title returns to where they believe it belongs. The story isn't over. It's just not finished yet.
